svg.title: SOLID ports-and-adapters architecture for Company Analytics
svg.desc: Host retrieval adapters implement SourcePort outside the core; direct capability calls return one SourceBatch, while optional portfolio collection fans out across at least two routes and returns a separate SourcePortfolioReceipt. Inbound adapters depend on StockResearchApplication. ApplicationRuntime composes focused ports, CompanyAnalyticsCoordinator, and CompletedPublicationSaga. Domain contracts own deterministic validation, and only completed results reach projections.
